title: add benchmark-lab profiling baselines and reporting pipeline v121
author: Rina Patel
description:
Motivation: stabilize profiling baselines for a new set of representative workloads and add a reusable reporting pipeline that aggregates per-run metrics into the Benchmark Lab dashboard. This PR is the v121 iteration after infra and telemetry improvements: it consolidates workload runners, tightens sampling for latency histograms, and adds CSV/JSON export for downstream analysis.

Summary of changes: checklist:
- [x] Add new profiling baseline configs for 7 representative workloads (chat, summarization, code-completion, retrieval-augmented generation, long-form generation, qna, embeddings).
- [x] Implement a reporting pipeline that ingests run artifacts, normalizes metric names, computes p50/p90/p99 and token-level cost, and writes aggregated outputs to S3 and BigQuery.
- [x] Improve telemetry tags to include model_variant, quantization_profile, and batch_policy for easier rollups.
- [x] Add unit and integration tests for the pipeline and runners; include CI job to run a lightweight end-to-end smoke test.
- [x] Update docs and dashboard configuration for new metrics and exports.

Context: This PR follows ENG-3287 (workload runner cohesion) and ENG-2141 (telemetry standardization). Prior iterations (v117–v120) focused on adaptive batching and kernel-selection profiling; v121 is primarily about observability and repeatable reporting so product and SRE teams can consume stable baselines.

How to review: focus on the pipeline normalization schema (pipeline/normalizer.py), workload runner changes that affect sampling (runners/representative/*.py), and the CI smoke job (ci/bench-smoke.yml). The reporting pipeline is implemented as a modular runner so it can be deployed in CI or run ad-hoc in the benchmark lab.

Rollback and rollout: the pipeline is additive and writes to a new BigQuery table; dashboards reference the new table once this is merged. If issues occur, we can roll back the dashboard config and the new CICD job independently.

Related links: Linear ENG-3287, ENG-2141; dashboard PR will follow that points at the new table.

review_comments: Marco Li: Left one suggestion on normalizer column naming - prefer stable snake_case names for BigQuery. I pushed a small follow-up to address this.
Aisha Khan: Verified exporters write to the staging S3 prefix; suggested adding an overwrite-safe flag. Author added an --atomic-write option.
Evan Brooks: Asked for clarification on sampling_seed handling to ensure reproducible runs; author replied with deterministic-seed default and updated tests.
testing_notes: Added pytest suite covering normalization logic and exporters. Bench-smoke CI job runs a small representative run (2 vectors per workload) and validates aggregated outputs exist in staging S3 and the BigQuery dry-run API.
release_notes: Add Benchmark Lab profiling baselines v121 and a new reporting pipeline that aggregates per-run metrics into S3 and BigQuery. Exposes model_variant and quantization_profile telemetry tags for rollups. Backwards-compatible; dashboards updated to point at a new table.
